description: Derived measurements and original human verdicts for the primary Wexcombe and Quenby comparisons; not raw browser evidence.
interpretation: Primary correctness uses the original human grades, with unscorable answers excluded. Automatic verdicts remain separate.
Closed-by-box slots have no human answer grade and count as not correct under the frozen protocol. They are excluded from resource comparisons.
Cost includes parsing where used and excludes local browser/infrastructure costs; no interrupted-attempt charge is assigned to completed trials.
Wexcombe has three template rounds and one held-out-wording round. Quenby has both completed rounds. Markets are never pooled.
Holm correction is over the four Wexcombe primary tests and the three Quenby primary tests separately.
This release reproduces primary counts, medians and tests from derived measurements, not trace extraction, grading, all sensitivity analyses or the full report.
Design B uses selected generated markets, one browser model/scaffold, and a label warning supplied only to the block.
